title: Quick Braised Slovakian Pork Dumplings
description: A weeknight Slovakian dish featuring Italian seasoning, pressure-cooked to perfection in ti-leaf wraps, resulting in a bouncy and umami-rich meal. This recipe combines the comfort of traditional Slovakian cuisine with the convenience of quick cooking.
instructions: Prepare the ti leaves by washing and patting them dry with paper towels.
In a large mixing bowl, combine the ground pork, Italian seasoning, chopped onion, minced garlic, salt, and black pepper, mixing well with your hands until just combined.
Lay a ti leaf flat on a work surface, with the stem end facing you, and place about 1/4 cup of the pork mixture in the center of the leaf.
Fold the stem end over the filling, then fold in the sides and roll the leaf into a tight cylinder, repeating with the remaining leaves and filling.
Heat the olive oil in the bottom of a pressure cooker over medium heat.
Add the dumplings to the pressure cooker, seam-side down, and pour in the chicken broth.
Close the lid of the pressure cooker and cook at high pressure for 10 minutes.
Allow the pressure to release naturally for 5 minutes, then quick-release any remaining pressure.
Serve the dumplings hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
